summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py. New tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed), and the extras suite passes (99 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing is committed. mypy, black, isort, and ruff were not run because none is installed in the shared venv and I did not install anything. Line lengths were checked by hand and are within 88 columns. The type-ignore placement is unverified, so warn_unused_ignores may still flag a line. I read "the line opening the expected-exception context" as the parser call inside the pytest.raises block.
